note:
R97a - exact census behind the R90 / R95 statement "the only database value in 55-66 is the Finnish arena's chantaudioid 61"
(25 September direction audit, correction 1). That sentence was never measured over the whole database: R90 tested (i) every
`exhibitionarena.chantaudioid` value against the bank set and (ii) the integer fields of the `exhibitionteams` / `exhibitionarena`
rows of the twelve matched clubs. This probe states the actual inspected population and measures the whole main database instead:

  for every gen7 main-database anchor (X360 / PS3 NHL 08-Legacy, 18 files; NHL 07 has the gen6 schema and no chant field - omitted,
  stated), for every table and every integer field (meta `FIELDTYPE_INTEGER`), count rows whose value lies in 55..66 (the club-bank
  numbers 055-066). Fields are classed by NAME only:
    audio-named : name contains one of audio / chant / horn / sound / music / song / anthem / crowd / voice / speech
    other       : everything else (index-like, colour, rating, date ... - numerical coincidences by construction)
  For audio-named hits the row identity is listed (table, row index, a name-like field if the table has one). For the other class only
  per-field counts are kept (they show how common 55-66 is as a plain number, i.e. why "equals a bank number" is not a binding).
  Also re-reported from the raw data: every `exhibitionarena` row with chantaudioid 61 (name, tenants where an `arenaid` link exists),
  reconciling the R90 handoff table row "arenas referencing a club bank 55-66 = 0" against the R90 JSON field
  `club_banks_referenced_by_any_arena_chantaudioid` (= [61] on all 11 trees).
Read-only over `anchors/`. Usage: python r97_chant_id_field_census.py <out.json>
